name: Can I prevent sewer smells from drains?

mainEntity.name: Can I prevent sewer smells from drains?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can take several preventive measures. Regularly run water in all drains, especially those in seldom-used sinks, showers, and floor drains, to keep P-traps full. Clean drains periodically to prevent clogs from accumulating hair, grease, and soap scum. Ensure that your plumbing system's vent pipes are clear of obstructions like leaves or bird nests. For properties with septic systems, regular maintenance and pumping are also crucial to prevent odor issues.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent sewer smells by regularly running water in all drains to keep P-traps full, cleaning drains to prevent clogs, and ensuring vent pipes are clear.
